scope: Test observation only; no worker/UI/persistence runtime modifications in this follow-up. No full browser run claimed.

deadlines: Dodge retains its 6000ms acknowledgment budget; rumor replaces unconditional 400ms sleep with correlated acknowledgment within 6000ms, below the existing 8000ms Playwright default. No existing timeout increased.

journalFailures.interpretation: Mailbox bounded and commits progressed; failure is residual drain latency, not data loss or limit violation. Roughly 34 normal ten-operation transactions remain.
journalFailures.proposedFix: Measure append encode/hash time, IndexedDB transaction latency and event-loop lag separately; coalesce already-queued contiguous same-epoch batches up to the existing 128-operation and 64KB batch limits. Preserve cursor/hash/CAS validation and checkpoint limits. Compare identical 100000-tick scenario sequentially on one idle host; require exact final replay, <=600 mailbox, no failed writes and the unchanged 15s settle deadline.

journalFailures.interpretation: Fails before competing writer conflict is exercised: initial base snapshot has not armed in 15s. A stale-writer correctness failure was not observed.
journalFailures.proposedFix: Measure snapshot roundtrip, encode/validation and initial full-save commit stages on same host. Coalescing tail writes will not fix this initialization bottleneck. Bound initial-save work only after stage measurements identify the cost; retain the 15s requirement.

journalFailures.interpretation: Fails in setup drain before actual context loss/recovery. A recovery correctness failure was not observed. At least 30 operations committed while 63 remained.
journalFailures.proposedFix: Same contiguous-batch append measurement as burst case; independently verify paused authority stops producing operations and tail drain finishes by unchanged 15s deadline. Then exercise real context loss. Do not label current evidence a context-loss failure.

limits: No measured production latency improvement is claimed; batching proposal remains unimplemented pending isolated stage timings.
